SELECT 'ITEM' AS targetType, i.id AS targetId, COALESCE(NULLIF(i.name_zh, ''), i.name, i.internal_name) AS title, COALESCE( ( SELECT ii.cached_url FROM item_images ii WHERE ii.item_id = i.id AND ii.deleted = 0 AND ii.status = 1 AND NULLIF(TRIM(ii.cached_url), '') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN ii.is_primary = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, ii.sort_order ASC, ii.id ASC LIMIT 1 ), NULLIF(TRIM(i.image), '') ) AS imageUrl, CONCAT('/items/', i.id) AS url, uif.created_at AS createdAt FROM user_item_favorites uif INNER JOIN items i ON i.id = uif.item_id AND i.deleted = 0 AND (i.status IS NULL OR i.status = 1) WHERE uif.user_id = #{userId} AND uif.deleted = 0 ORDER BY uif.created_at DESC, uif.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
